headline_seed: Massachusetts primary results live updates: Markey’s age becomes key test - USA Today
draft_text:
Sen. Ed Markey, 80, defeated Rep. Seth Moulton in Massachusetts's Democratic Senate primary Tuesday, per AP and USA Today.
Markey led by nearly 3-to-1 with 75% of the vote in.
This cat watched the margins hold.

And that's the mews.
